title: "Crypto Markets"
author: "Grady Woodard"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect()
metadata <- open_dataset("data/coin_metadata.parquet") |>
  collect()
categories <- open_dataset("data/categories.parquet") |>
  collect()
crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(select(categories, -description), by = "category_id") |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date_raw))
```

```{r}
category_market_caps <- crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(category_name = fct_reorder(category_name, market_cap_usd, .fun = mean))

event_windows <- tribble(
  ~event, ~start, ~end,
  "Luna/UST crash", as.Date("2022-05-07"), as.Date("2022-05-12"),
  "FTX collapse", as.Date("2022-11-08"), as.Date("2022-11-11")
) |>
  mutate(label_y = c(0.98, 0.88))

ggplot(category_market_caps, aes(x = date, y = market_cap_usd, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  geom_rect(
    data = event_windows,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = event_windows,
    aes(x = start, y = label_y, label = event),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "cividis", name = "Category") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of market capitalization",
    title = "Crypto Market-Cap Share by Category",
    subtitle = "Daily category shares across 22 tracked coins; each day totals 100%",
    caption = "Source: Daily price, coin metadata, and category parquet files supplied with this analysis."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line(color = "#0072B2", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Daily price (USD)",
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price",
    subtitle = "Historical daily prices across the full dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title.position = "plot")
```
